transcript.t: I used to study without a plan, and my grades did not improve. Then my teacher gave me some advice.
First, make a clear plan for each week. Second, after each lesson, summarize the main points in a few sentences. Third, ask for feedback and learn from your mistakes.
I also began to take advantage of free online resources, such as videos and podcasts.
Now I study step by step, and I enjoy it more. My teacher says a good method is more important than studying for many hours.
